name: Permethrin Soap for prevention of scabies 75g
description:
Product Name: Permethrin Soap
Net Weight: 75g
Formulation: Topical Soap
Composition: Each gram contains Permethrin 1% w/w
Status: Prescription Only Drug

Description

Permethrin Soap is specially formulated to help in the prevention and treatment of scabies, a skin condition caused by tiny mites. The active ingredient Permethrin (a pyrethrin) works by paralyzing and killing mites along with their eggs.

It is generally prescribed alongside Permethrin creams or lotions for regular bathing during treatment and continued use after treatment to prevent re-infestation.
